comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus arrange a water meter with prescribed upstream and downstream straight runs.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed unlocking, fine collar rotation, locking, and physical cycling versus component and pipe placement to length ratios.
comparison.success_condition: Dynamic stop quality and setting stability versus 10 pipe diameters before and 5 after the meter. The record supplies no specs or placement tolerances.
comparison.reason: Static piping-layout compliance does not test force-controlled mechanical tuning.
